samples.summary: Unrelated scope: adding `readOnly` to the editor-mount effect's deps is a permissions fix, not part of #1045
samples.evidence: The originating task (docs/tasks/active/20260907-docs-select-all-type-undo-todo.md) scopes the change to undo granularity (`withUndoUnit`, `deleteSelection`, composite actions, the Yorkie undo floor, tests, docs-collaboration.md). Nothing in it touches share-link permission re-resolution. Adding `readOnly` to `[didMount, doc, readOnly]` changes mount/teardown behaviour for the whole docs editor (a permission flip now disposes and rebuilds the editor, losing in-editor state), which is an independent behavioural change riding along on an undo PR and is not recorded in any design doc or task item. It may well be a real bug fix, but it belongs in its own change where it can be reviewed and tested as one.

samples.summary: Unrelated scope: new `disposed || pasting || readOnly` re-validation (and two new tests) in the Cmd+Shift+V path
samples.evidence: `if (this.disposed || this.pasting || this.readOnly) return;` after the awaited clipboard read is a lifecycle/permission hardening change, not an undo-granularity change; the #1045 plan lists only `withUndoUnit` for `pastePlainTextFromClipboard`. Two of the new tests in packages/docs/test/view/large-paste-indicator.test.ts exist solely for this guard. Harmless functionally, but it widens the PR beyond the issue and its acceptance list.

samples.summary: The incremental-layout invariant changed but only docs-collaboration.md was updated; the canonical rendering doc still states the old rule
samples.evidence: docs-rendering-optimization.md documents `dirtyBlockIds = undefined; // reset after layout` (line 197) and "Race between dirty tracking and render | dirtyBlockIds is reset synchronously inside recomputeLayout" (line 246). The new `requestLayoutRefresh` in packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts saves and *restores* `dirtyBlockIds` after `recomputeLayout()`, and converts a previously-`undefined` (full-recompute) set into an empty set. That is a change to the layout-cache invariant this doc owns; the explanation was written into docs-collaboration.md (the undo doc) instead, so the rendering doc now describes behaviour that no longer holds for all callers.

searchedFor: grep this.deleteSelection() call sites in packages/docs/src
samples.summary: Same 50-entry data-loss failure remains on the toolbar/replace-all per-block write paths; deferred to an issue rather than fixed
samples.evidence: The updated design doc admits `toggleList` / `indent` / `outdent` / `applyBlockStyle`, the cell-range style loop and `FindReplaceState.replaceAll()` still write once per block outside a batch, so they hit the identical `MaxUndoRedoStackDepth` data loss on large selections. The task's Goal is scoped to "every selection-replacing edit", so this is arguably out of scope and is honestly documented and tracked (#1048) — but the user-visible defect class (undo silently loses content) survives this change on those paths, which is worth weighing before closing #1045.
